capabilities: Assign colors to folders from the folder context menu
Inherit folder colors to contained files and subfolders
Build a palette with named colors, hex values, and a color picker
Toggle color display in explorer icons, explorer names, and tab icons
Recover saved settings if they cannot be loaded or saved
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.14.4+); macOS/Linux and other themes are not yet validated and mobile support is future work. Optional donations via Ko-fi.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer and tabs have no built-in way to color-code folders, making projects and vault sections hard to spot.

relations.evidence: This project began with the official Obsidian sample plugin; the original license and attribution are preserved in NOTICE.

summary: Folder color tool that assigns colors to folders and lets them flow to contained files, subfolders, and tab icons.
